text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen and I continue to split our time
between recruitment and
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen and I continue to split our time
between recruitment and
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, our search for new team
members bears no fruit, and
McQueen
remains the sole member of Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While that's a problem in and of itself, it's
the least of my worries.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen has been going out late at night
to train alone on an empty
track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I just need to pick up the pace a little
more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I expected, she clearly isn't satisfied
with the regimens I've
prepared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I expected, she clearly isn't satisfied
with the regimens I've
prepared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho is fast approaching,
however. This extra strain
poses a risk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Should I tell her she needs to stop? Or
should I accept the risk and
make my
sessions more rigorous?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've no choice. No choice but to win the
spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What do I do? The old man would have
known exactly what to say. If
only he
could help me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I head to the office to
prepare for training. There, I
find
McQueen waiting with unexpected
company.
Hello! Hope you don't mind me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, no. This is Mejiro Ryan, one
of my dear family
members.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It would appear that she wishes to speak
to you about something, so I
have brought
her along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you! It's kind of important, so
I practically begged her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now if you'll excuse me, I have some
potential teammates to recruit.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're not joining in on the
conversation?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It appears to be something of secrecy, so Ryan insisted that it just be the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I know how much of a distraction I can be,
so now let me make myself
sparse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Any cheeky secrets you two
want to keep are of no concern
to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So please, by all means, take your time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Aww, looks like she got all jealous.
It's not like I was going to
steal her trainer
away.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: So what's this important conversation?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, well it's about McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You've probably already noticed, but she's
pushing herself way too
hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I knew you would have picked up on them.
Yup, McQueen was right
about you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"A bit unreliable, but always looking out
for me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's how she always describes you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She even said that's why she'll stick with
you until the end, no matter
what
happens.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Really? And here I thought that she didn't
trust me at all.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Really? And here I thought that she didn't
trust me at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought she was training alone because
she was unsatisfied with my
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Nah, she really does trust you a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But if I had to guess, her personal goals for
the race are getting to
her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
See, when a race plays to our strengths, a
Mejiro's expected to win it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know the family has high expectations for
me when it comes to
Classic races.
McQueen is a stayer, so expectations are
high for her to
win the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Especially given how much the Tenno Sho
means to the family. She
wants to make
everybody proud.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Expectations for her to race in the Tenno Sho have existed since she was young. Under that pressure, McQueen probably feels like she has to win.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why she's been training by
herself every night.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why she's been training by
herself every night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I think she's worried, y'know? She's juggling the race and recruiting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She feels like it's on her to get it all
perfect. Trust me, she's always
been like
this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's putting up a tough front. Maybe the
extra training is her way of
trying to cope.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So please, stop her before she hurts
herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she would listen to anything you
have to say if you explain it
to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yeesh, just what have I been doing all this
time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, just what have I been doing all this
time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All I did was move up the ranks a bit. I
can't believe I let that cloud
my vision.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ryan. You've helped me
refocus on what's really
important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen's like a little sister to me, but
she's also an important rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll leave the rest to you!
